subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support a moving-main npm `dev` dist-tag, or should the docs and update-channel guidance make dev installs git-only?
rationale: Source and live registry evidence show the channel is missing, but enabling it changes package distribution and release credential boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent release/security policy.

options.title: Retire npm dev selector
options.body: Update release-channel, installer, updater, FAQ, and release docs so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add a first-class secure publish path with versioning, approvals, provenance, credential isolation, rollback, tests, and registry readback before enabling `openclaw@dev`.

options.title: Keep policy undecided
options.body: Leave this issue open as a release-owner decision while current dev users continue using the git checkout path.

recommendation.title: Retire npm dev selector
recommendation.body: Update release-channel, installer, updater, FAQ, and release docs so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal across release workflow/docs and already reviewed this exact release-path gap.
